title: Thai Apple Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, these sweet and savory pastries combine the flavors of Thailand with the warmth of autumn. Perfect for a cozy evening or a festive gathering.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to desired thickness.
Place a spoonful of sliced apples in the center of each dough circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of coconut sugar, Thai red curry paste, cinnamon, and nutmeg over the apples.
Fold the dough in half to form a triangle or square shape, and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with melted butter and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
